description: An id defined twice in one locale.

cases.name: a dotted key and a nested one that join to one id

findings.message: `a.b` is defined again in `en`, so one of the two messages is never read.

cases.name: an id under two spellings of one locale with different text

findings.message: `hi` is also defined in `en-us`, the same locale written another way, so a host that reads the two as one never reads one of the two messages.
`en-US` is `en-us` written another way, so a host that looks a locale up as written reads only the messages under the one it is asked for.

cases.name: an id under two spellings, then again under the second

findings.message: `hi` is also defined in `en-us`, the same locale written another way, so a host that reads the two as one never reads one of the two messages.
`en-US` is `en-us` written another way, so a host that looks a locale up as written reads only the messages under the one it is asked for.
`hi` is defined again in `en-US`, so one of the two messages is never read.

cases.name: an id the second spelling defines first, with the same text

findings.message: `en-US` is `en-us` written another way, so a host that looks a locale up as written reads only the messages under the one it is asked for.
`a` is defined again in `en-us`, so one of the two messages is never read.

findings.message: `en-US` is `en-us` written another way, so a host that looks a locale up as written reads only the messages under the one it is asked for.
